<!--
  The filled body of the CartDrawer: the lines with a quantity field, then the free-delivery bar, the subtotal
  and total and the button.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { CartLine, CartLabels } from "../blocks/cart-list.types";
import type { SummaryRow } from "../blocks/order-summary.types";
import type { DrawerLabels } from "../blocks/cart-drawer.types";

export type DrawerLinesProps = {
  lines: CartLine[];
  rows: SummaryRow[];
  labels: CartLabels;
  drawer: DrawerLabels;
  media?: "image" | "none";
  field?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Button from "../compose/Button.vue";
import Group from "../compose/Group.vue";
import Inline from "../compose/Inline.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import Progress from "../compose/Progress.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import NumberField from "../components/number-field.vue";
import { fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

const { lines, rows, labels, drawer, media = "image", field = "qty" } = defineProps<DrawerLinesProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Stack gap="4" align="stretch" class="flex-1 p-4" data-testid="lines">
    <Group v-for="line in lines" :key="line.id" gap="4" align="start" data-testid="item">
      <MediaFrame v-if="((media as string) === 'image')" :alt="line.name" ratio="1/1" class="size-16 shrink-0" />
      <Stack gap="2" align="stretch" class="flex-1">
        <Group gap="2" justify="between" align="start">
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {{ line.name }}
          </Text>
          <Inline class="text-sm font-medium">
            {{ fmtMoney((line.price * line.qty), line.currency) }}
          </Inline>
        </Group>
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ line.variant }}
        </Text>
        <NumberField
          :value="(line.qty == null ? undefined : String(line.qty))"
          :name="tpl('{0}-{1}', field, line.id)"
          min="1"
          :label="labels.qty"
          :decrease="labels.decrease"
          :increase="labels.increase"
        />
      </Stack>
    </Group>
  </Stack>
  <Stack gap="4" align="stretch" class="border-t border-border p-4">
    <Stack gap="2" align="stretch" class="rounded bg-muted p-4" data-testid="progress">
      <Text size="sm">
        {{ drawer.progress }}
      </Text>
      <Progress value="96" max="100" :aria-label="drawer.progress" />
    </Stack>
    <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <template v-for="(row, i) in rows" :key="row.id">
        <ListItem v-if="(row.strong ? true : (i === 0))"
          :class="
            row.strong ? 'flex justify-between text-base font-bold'
            : 'flex justify-between text-sm text-muted-foreground'
          "
        >
          <Inline>
            {{ row.label }}
          </Inline>
          <Inline>
            {{ fmtMoney(row.amount, row.currency) }}
          </Inline>
        </ListItem>
      </template>
    </List>
    <Button variant="default" size="lg" class="w-full" data-testid="checkout">
      {{ labels.checkout }}
    </Button>
  </Stack>
</template>
